help.title: Command Help
help.intro_fallback: Here are the commands you can use:
help.usage_hint: Browse a category with the menu below, or use `/help command:<name>` for one command in full.
help.context_menu: Right-click a message or member and look under Apps
help.category_empty: No commands in this category are available to you.
help.detail_hint: Use /help command:<name> for options and notes

details.activity: `create` opens a form (title, description, start time, sign-up deadline, capacity) and posts the activity here; the optional `role` limits who can join. Members join or withdraw with buttons; participants are pinged when sign-ups close and when it starts. The organizer or a moderator can close sign-ups, start a roll call from the post, or `cancel` it.
details.ai: Chatting needs a whitelist entry from an admin; `settings` picks the model, temperature and system prompt, and `status` shows them.
details.archive: Bot admins only, in the debug channel: manage full and periodic backups.
details.ban_user: Tomori and Nijika use this server’s configured vote threshold, voting window, eligible roles and default timeout, counting current human voters. Timeouts stay within 1–5 minutes and require Discord moderation permission. Other personalities retain their existing defaults.
details.bug_report: Each report opens a ticket in the bot admins' forum; their replies reach you by DM, and replying to that DM adds details. At most three open reports each, and one new report per ten minutes.
details.change_avatar: Switch the bot's avatar, nickname and colour; Discord limits how often the avatar can change.
details.feed: Configure public social, forum and video subscriptions in a private platform-specific editor.
details.give_score: Just for fun: a random score from 0 to 10.
details.giveaway: `create` opens a form for the prize, winners and duration (1 minute-30 days); members enter with 🎉. `delete` cancels your own giveaways; moderators can cancel any.
details.help: Without options it shows the overview; with `command` it shows one command in full.
details.level_detail: Without options it shows the MEE6 leaderboard, ten members per page; only the member who ran it can turn the pages. `rank` opens the page holding that rank and marks it. `member` shows one member's card with level progress, average XP per message, an estimate of the messages to the next level and the gap to the rank above; it takes priority when `rank` is also given. The leaderboard must be public, covers the top 1,000 members and is cached for five minutes.
details.menu_get_avatar: Shows a member's avatar, preferring their server avatar.
details.menu_author_avatar: Shows the message author's avatar, preferring their server avatar.
details.menu_get_sticker: Shows a message's stickers and custom emoji with links to the files.
details.menu_give_score: Scores a message for fun; each message keeps its score for the day.
details.random_restaurant: Suggests a random restaurant in Taipei and parts of New Taipei.
details.reply: After `add`, the bot answers any message **exactly** matching the keyword; the keyword `[*]` makes the bot interject at random. Replies never ping anyone. `delete` removes your own pairs; members who manage messages can remove any.
details.role: `panel` posts role buttons (requires Manage Roles; only ordinary roles below you and the bot); `temp` creates notification roles that expire, up to three active per member; `sync` syncs MEE6 level roles, at most once every ten minutes.
details.roll_call: Call `users`, a `role`, or an `activity`'s participants (up to 50; no @everyone). Called members press Check in; when the `deadline` passes or the caller closes it, absentees are listed. A roll call taken from an activity shows its attendance on the activity post.
details.talk: Signed as "display name(username)" by default; `channel` posts elsewhere, but only where you can post yourself. Members and roles can be pinged, @everyone/@here cannot. `anonymous` posts unsigned, bot admins only.
details.thread: `ban`/`allow`/`list` run inside a thread for its owner, delegates and bot admins; `claim` requests delegated management; `manager` is for bot admins.
details.traffic: Counts activity in channels you can see; `user` is private by default, the others public, and `visibility` changes either.
details.db: Bot admins only, on Nijika. A read-only view of every guild database: statistics, fields, browsing with filters, and single documents. Every option offers a list to pick from, and it works in DMs.
details.settings: Open the private server settings panel. Managers can delegate selected preferences to roles or all members; access and protected settings remain manager-only. Changes apply after saving.
